deities.name: The Hive Mother
deities.description: Patron of the Willowmere Sisters. Offerings of mead and honey are poured on her shrine stones; she rewards patience and punishes waste.

deities.name: The Tide Warden
deities.description: Old sea-power of the coast. Lighthouse keepers swore oaths to the Warden; its chapel sank beneath the Old Moss long ago.
